admission.justification: Backend classification and the shared pane must preserve binary metadata rather than decoding control bytes into viewer text.

applicability: File and note content classified as unsupported binary content before viewer text presentation.
conditions: The existing binary probe or UTF-8 decoding result identifies the content as binary.
The read result supplies its measured byte count rather than decoded binary text.
exclusions: Supported media content rendered by MediaView.
Changing the existing text-route size limit.

evidence: producer-proof-locators.json: BUG-R05@v1 §7; mcp/tests/test_serving_files.py::RouteTests::test_a_nul_bearing_text_suffix_is_binary_not_control_text; mcp/tests/test_notes_folder.py::test_a_nul_bearing_note_is_binary_not_control_text; dashboard/src/panels/notes-reader/NotesReaderViewer.test.tsx :: degrades a binary note to a byte-count placeholder instead of raw bytes

statement: Unsupported binary file content is represented as binary file metadata with its byte count rather than decoded text.
